item.tib: mkha' 'gro gsang gcod nor bu'i chu 'grim dmigs skor nor bu'i do shal skal ldan mgul brgyan
item.coloph: de ltar chu 'grim lag len 'di/ rang ngos nas gong ma'i phyag bzhes la brten/ gzhan sde la dpe blangs nas chu 'grim skabs/ rang slob dam ldan rnams kyis bskul bar/ dang du ma blang btang snyoms su bzhag par/ slar bdag cag gi drin can bla ma dam pa'i mtshan gyi cod paN 'chang ba'i yongs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku mchog rin po che g.yung drung bstan rgyal kyis zhal nas bka' phab par/ dang du blang nas rnga ljong gyi skyabs mchog bsod nams mtshan can la/ yi ge lam nas lag len rtogs 'bul byas tshe cho ge'i bka' gsung gser gyi me tog spyi bor rtsal nas/ rang ngos nas bon 'di bag chags 'jog pa dang / rang slob dad dang dam tshig dang du len par snying dang 'dra ba spyi dang / khyad par sha tsha'i dam tshig gcig tu 'brel zhing / rnam dkar dge spyod las la phyogs gcig tu chu dang 'o ma ltar/ dbyer med 'dres pa'i gcod kyi gra tshogs rib kang gser mo ljang dang khri ka bde skyid kyi zhing stong che chung gi rtse (brtse) grogs snying gi dngas ma rnams dang / rang yul gyi gra (grwa)slob na mnyam/ las kyi 'brel ba'i tsha bo rnams kyi 'dod pa ltar dpe la bkod/ slar yang snyan chen spral pa gyer chen mu la pradzanya'i yang sprul drung mu ha ra dang / stong chen dgon gyi snying rje dge rgan tshul khrims ye shes dang byang 'dren kun rgyal rnams la chu 'grim dmigs khrid khrid du phul skabs/ khongs rnams kyi bka' yis bskul bar mkha' 'gro ma lus byas nas stag tshangs ljong gi chu mig 'grim pa'i lam kha nas rtse dbus chos rje kyis sbyar ba'i dge ba'i (bas) rgyal bstan rin po che'i srid mtha'i bar du gnas shing lus can bde skyid la spyod pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig gu//
